_note: Owner-supplied images (DARK-THEME.md 'Client update 8': the studio owner's OWN designs and sites, supplied 14 Oct) for the What We Create service cards. They are not portfolio projects: no project caption; their cards link to The Work page.

scripts/prepare_supplied.py converts each 'file' from 'src' into public/assets/supplied/<name>-<width>.webp (640/1280/1920, never upscaled; 'crop' = [left, top, right, bottom] in source pixels, applied first) and writes scripts/supplied-manifest.json. The build references them through lib.supplied(), so only images a page uses reach dist/.

fit: 'cover' (default) or 'contain' (the whole design, centred on its own 'ground' colour - for a design whose headline any 4:3 crop would cut; 'fade': 'bottom' dissolves its bottom edge into the ground, e.g. OBSCURA's model). focal: object-position of a 'cover' image in the service cards (keep the device / the website's headline in view). alt: what the image shows (shared by every card that shows it).

check.py fails when an image mapped in sections/service_cards.MEDIA is missing from the manifest, a variant file is missing or not a valid WebP of the recorded size, or a recorded crop differs from this table.
